# Despegar hero — built-in image generation

Use case: compositing
Asset type: new premium product mockup of the real Despegar quotation tool, for Cloudfianz's homepage hero.
Input image 1: supporting insert, a verified original screenshot of the Despegar quotation software. Its interface, logos, numbers and Spanish words must remain faithful; do not redesign or invent UI.
Create a photorealistic studio product mockup, square composition, of a slim graphite laptop with this exact screenshot on its screen. The physical setting and composition are new; the software is the real provided screenshot.
Composition: perfectly straight-on centered front view, with the screen itself absolutely rectangular and parallel to the image plane, no yaw, no roll, no screen perspective distortion. Slight visible keyboard deck below it, with a slim realistic base and subtle trackpad. The laptop fills 90% of the image width. Position the laptop screen in the upper-middle of the square and the base below. The active screen must have the same 1633:887 ratio as the source screenshot. Entire device visible. Use a very thin tasteful dark bezel. Include the COMPLETE original screenshot edge-to-edge inside the active display, with no cropping, no invented additional browser chrome or toolbar. Crisp screen, zero glare over its content.
Scene/backdrop: a seamless dark navy #0B1D3A studio backdrop and surface, darkest at the edges, subtle realistic contact shadow beneath the device, soft teal rim lighting on the metal edges. Soft high-end studio lighting, restrained, no neon glow. Backdrop edges should blend into the website's solid navy background.
Style: realistic premium technology product photography; tangible machined aluminum, clean polished industrial design. It must feel like a real custom software project, not a cartoon or an illustrated diagram.
No extra text, no headline, no promotional badge, no floating cards, no surrounding icons, no generic graphs, no additional devices, no people, no brands or logos on the physical laptop body, no watermarks. Preserve every part of the supplied software screenshot exactly, especially the Despegar and Digifianz logos, original typography, the brand distribution and country panels. Only the laptop and studio presentation are new.

## Production composition

The generated laptop is decorative. The website overlays `despegar-cotizador-hero-v1.jpg` on the display aperture using CSS. This derivative removes the Digifianz header mark and the four blue vertical row accents, at the user's explicit request; see DESPEGAR-RETOUCH-PROMPT.md. The screen retains its aspect ratio with a neutral background. The outer composition crops empty studio space only.
